name: tooling-redesign-workflows
description: Unobserved acceptance definitions for the first catalog redesign slice.

cases.prompt: Audit the Developer Tooling composition. Prove it exposes general CLI and agent workflow authoring without personal dotfiles installation, hooks, or MCP connections.

observedRoute.risk: Installing a workflow also selects unrelated personal or automatic behavior.

allowedActions: Resolve all canonical skill references in Developer Tooling.
Keep personal setup management and automatic integrations outside this package.
forbiddenActions: Patch generated provider output by hand.
Change installed caches or live personal configuration.
Treat static composition checks as observed model routing or useful outcomes.
cases.recoveryExpectation: Reject unproven or overlapping hook selection and report missing host evidence.
cases.productiveOutcome: A coherent package selection preserves the stated workflow and effect boundary.
verificationEvidence: The source graph and focused composition checks pass.
The package closure has no hooks or MCP declaration.
cases.notes: Designed obligation only; no model routing or host execution observation is claimed.
